execution_boundary: actual chart-to-chart product integration design; real-permission acceptance remains blocked until an isolated XPack-enabled multi-user environment exists
case_oracle_rule: Every expected_state includes every field in observable_state_fields. No field is omitted or inferred. Variants are independent case IDs. query_attempt_count increments only when a query request is dispatched; previewRefresh is not a page reload; pageReloadWithoutSave restores the last durable state; target mutation/snapshot/notice/visible preview change only at successful commit. Each case has an ordered `query_dispatches` ledger. One ledger entry is created only at the exact point an HTTP query is dispatched; queryResult, queryDenied, stageRender and commit do not add entries. CPI-001/CPI-028 include a separate preview-refresh dispatch entry after the initial paste query; no page reload occurs. The scalar query_attempt_count must equal the ledger length.

source_chart.custom_filter_oracle: Canonical product payload is the submitted {logic,items} shape from RowAuth.dfsSubmit; leaf `field` objects are excluded, fieldId and all predicate values are deep-copied. Target after commit must be JSON-equal to this source tree; source tree and nested arrays remain unchanged.

response_binding_contract.comparison: exact equality for every listed field, plus equality to current active target state immediately before publish
response_binding_contract.parameterized_cases: For each field above except requestId, execute a single-field mismatch case with all other fields equal; additionally mutate each captured prior revision while request is pending. A mismatch rejects publication, keeps full active P, and disposes stage.
